bundle_provenance.host: F47d shared Rust ClassicHost arena; AEX setup, native candidate setup and selected render route
bundle_provenance.world: same ARGB worlds: input padding rounded up to pixel alignment, 0xA5 fill; output packed in both runs; generated output_padding unused

source_provenance.host: Original AEX Unicorn CPU per-route; production Mac EffectMain Classic + Smart fake host
source_provenance.layer: None; independent layer worlds outside this adapter
source_provenance.mac_host: existing public key/gamma CLI SDK shim, production EffectMain; Classic added using same params/worlds
source_provenance.mac_stride: shared randomly padded input/output stride plus 32-byte guards
source_provenance.reference_limit: Retained host imports are not native Windows UCRT or AE proof
source_provenance.stage_support: existing public replay helpers expose final raw output only
source_provenance.world: full frame, origin 0, downsample 1:1, raw ARGB, no conversion
